The forelimbs are visible, appearing columnar, while the hindlimbs are partially visible but blend into the background. The tail is not clearly defined.

The geometry of the horns is slightly ambiguous; the connection points to the skull are not sharply defined, and the proportions seem slightly off compared to typical Triceratops reconstructions, though this could be artistic license.
